name: Yin Yue Chenxing zhi Ke
source:
A fan-made R18 SakaGin (Sakamoto x Gintoki) game made out of love, a birthday tribute to Sakamoto Tatsuma. It's a visual novel, very small in size. The right to interpret copyright belongs to the original work Gintama.
